messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync: NimbusGrid x Redwood webinar at PlatformSummit next Tue. Need speaker list, demo fallback, kit split, and coupon card.
Oliver (Events): Slot is 11:00am PT. Format 30m talk + 20m hands-on pods. Who's confirmed?
Sana (NimbusGrid): I'll lead the talk. Jiro (HW) will run the bench. Sending logos now.
Eve (Redwood Eng): I'll do the runtime demo. Fallback = Redwood hosted sandbox + recorded clip if HW quota hits.
Eve (Redwood Eng): Warmup command for runbook: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":6}'`
Jon (Ops): Kit plan: 140 carry-on kits. Contents: USB-C cable, sticker sheet, postcard with QR + single-use coupon. Shipping PO needed Mon 9am to meet print cutoff.
Ava (Supply): Estimated cost ~$7.2k. Placeholder label DHL-TEMP-321. Will update tracking after PO.
Priya (Marketing): Need headshots + 1-line bios by Mon EOD. I'll build the QR landing page + short post-demo survey.
Maya (Partnerships): Can we include a quickstart sticker with a short coupon code? Good conversion.
Sana (NimbusGrid): Coupon OK. Suggest code NIMBUS-RWD-EXPO. We'll validate on our side.
Oliver (Events): Run-through Fri 10:00am PT. Volunteers for on-site pickup and pod leads?
Jon (Ops): Volunteers: Jon, Jiro, Maya. I'll own manifest and packing. Will post manifest Wed 6pm PT.
calendar-bot: Invite created -> 'NimbusGrid x Redwood Webinar - Runthrough' Fri 10:00am PT. RSVP updated.
Maya (Partnerships): Action recap: 1) Sana -> logos + coupon confirm, 2) Ava -> PO + label (Mon AM), 3) Priya -> assets + QR (Mon EOD), 4) Jon -> manifest (Wed 6pm). Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
